source: measured: converted-beta-0ec3c44, 54 poems, 233,233 entries, 16 Oct 2026, tools/measure_typing_rates.mjs (typingOnly set, aggregates only)
note: Parameter file for tools/generate_long_midst.mjs. Every scalar has a nominal value, a range, the basis of that range and its source; override a nominal with --set path=value. Whole-document rewrites (inserted or removed > 1000 characters; 671 of them, 0.29% of edits) are deliberately NOT modelled: in a multi-million-character text one would copy millions of characters, which is not what happens in a real few-thousand-character poem. Quantile tables are read between their points on a log scale. Table ends that the aggregates do not give (marked assumed) are stated in the figure's own note.

multiCharQuantiles.source: derived from the measured inserted-characters quantiles above: edits inserting 2+ characters are 1 - 0.668 - (0.148 + 0.037) = 14.7% of all edits; p90 = 2 puts 4.7% of edits at exactly 2 (32% of the 2+ edits); p99 = 15 puts 93% of the 2+ edits at 15 or fewer. The top end (40 characters) is ASSUMED: the measured quantiles stop at p99.

lengthQuantiles.source: measured: converted-beta-0ec3c44, 54 poems, 233,233 entries, 16 Oct 2026, tools/measure_typing_rates.mjs (typingOnly set, aggregates only); run = consecutive remove-only edits. The top end (40) is ASSUMED: the measured quantiles stop at p99.

removedCharsPerEdit.source: calibrated, NOT measured: how many characters one remove-only edit takes out was not in the aggregates; chosen so a full-length generated file has about the measured 2.28 edits per final character

gapMs.source: measured: converted-beta-0ec3c44, 54 poems, 233,233 entries, 16 Oct 2026, tools/measure_typing_rates.mjs (typingOnly set, aggregates only); points at p5..p99 are the measured gap quantiles, the points at 2 s, 10 s, 60 s, 10 min and 1 h are the measured shares of gaps above them (0.0719, 0.0247, 0.00487, 0.00116, 0.00083). The floor (10 ms at p0) and the top end (4 h at p100) are ASSUMED.
